skill.name: theme-factory
skill.description: Toolkit for applying curated color and font themes to slides, documents, reports, and HTML landing pages.

content.value_statement: Designing consistent slides and documents takes time when colors and fonts are chosen manually. This skill applies curated themes or creates a custom theme for the artifact.
actual_capabilities: Shows a PDF showcase of ten available themes for visual selection.
Applies selected theme colors and fonts to slides, documents, reports, or HTML pages.
Uses theme files that define hex color palettes and header and body fonts.
Supports custom theme generation when preset themes do not fit the artifact.
Checks visual consistency, contrast, and readability after applying a theme.
limitations: It does not create original brand strategy or logo systems.
It depends on the host tool to edit the target artifact.
It cannot guarantee font availability outside the listed theme specifications.
It requires user confirmation before applying a chosen preset theme.

use_cases.title: Restyle Client Presentations
use_cases.description: Apply a polished palette and font pairing to an existing slide deck before delivery.

use_cases.title: Prepare Branded Reports
use_cases.description: Use a consistent theme across reports, executive summaries, and supporting visuals.

use_cases.title: Create Campaign Visuals
use_cases.description: Generate or select a theme for landing pages, launch decks, and marketing documents.

prompt_templates.title: Apply a Preset Theme
prompt_templates.prompt: Show me the available theme showcase, then help me choose one theme for this presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Theme Fit
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare Ocean Depths, Modern Minimalist, and Tech Innovation for this investor deck. Recommend the best fit and explain the tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Custom Theme
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request when presets are not enough.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a custom theme for a premium healthcare analytics report. Include colors, fonts, intended tone, and review it before applying it.

prompt_templates.title: Unify Multiple Artifacts
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply one coherent theme across the slide deck, executive summary, and landing page. Preserve readability and keep visual hierarchy consistent.

output_examples.input: A consulting deck needs a calm professional style for a financial services audience.
output_examples.output: The skill recommends Ocean Depths, applies navy and teal accents, and uses DejaVu Sans fonts for a restrained executive tone.

output_examples.input: A startup launch page needs a high-energy technology look.
output_examples.output: The skill selects Tech Innovation, uses electric blue and neon cyan highlights, and keeps text contrast high on dark sections.

output_examples.input: No preset theme matches a boutique wellness report.
output_examples.output: The skill drafts a custom soft natural palette, pairs readable fonts, and waits for approval before applying the design.

best_practices: Review the showcase before selecting a preset theme.
Confirm the target audience and artifact type before applying styles.
Check contrast, spacing, and font consistency after the theme is applied.
anti_patterns: Applying a theme without user confirmation.
Mixing multiple preset themes in one artifact without a design reason.
Changing content meaning while adjusting visual style.

faq.question: What kinds of artifacts can this skill style?
faq.answer: It can style slides, documents, reports, and HTML landing pages when the host tool can edit them.

faq.question: How many preset themes are included?
faq.answer: The skill includes ten preset themes with color palettes, font pairings, and suggested use cases.

faq.question: Can it create a new theme?
faq.answer: Yes. It can generate a custom theme from a brief and ask for review before applying it.

faq.question: Does it choose the theme automatically?
faq.answer: It can recommend themes, but the instructions require explicit user confirmation before applying one.

faq.question: Does it include brand assets?
faq.answer: No. It provides colors and fonts, but it does not include logos, imagery, or full brand guidelines.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
